scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to show empathy at [03:15] when customer expressed emotional distress and humiliation over being penalised for visual impairment.

grader.scenario: Exemption request for £3.50 monthly paper billing fee for visual impairment accessibility
grader.notes: Excellent technical and procedural handling of accessibility fee waiver and large-print flag, but agent failed empathy when customer voiced humiliation and distress over disability charges.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net billing customer services' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Fatima throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer expressed acute distress and humiliation regarding disability fee penalties; agent completely ignored feelings and defended batch runs.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent restated the £3.50 fee waiver request and large-print accessibility requirements accurately at [01:25].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent confirmed contact landline number without repeating questions.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent applied £3.50 ledger credit and attached permanent RNIB Accessibility Exemption flag.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained a courteous and helpful tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked relevant questions regarding statement dates and invoice details.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed ledger credit applied and accepted large-print exemption setup.
